title: Every Door in This House Is a Lie

lines.t: In this town, there's a house where every door is a lie. And I have one hour to get out.
Nobody has ever made it out. Not even the mailman. He went in with one letter, three years ago.
The Mayor locked me in himself. If I escape in time, I win five thousand dollars. If I don't, I mow his lawn for a whole year.
Minute one. Stairs! I ran up all of them, and hit my head on the ceiling. They just stop.
Minute ten. A big red door. I yanked it open. Behind it? A brick wall.
Minute twenty. My best friend Benny yelled from outside. Try the window! I opened it. Behind it was another window.
And behind that one? Benny's face. Squished on the glass.
Minute thirty. A door on the second floor. I stepped through it, and fell straight into the kitchen sink.
Minute forty. A tiny door, the size of a shoebox. I squeezed through. Brooms. Just brooms.
Minute fifty. The big screen on the square said ten minutes left. The whole town was watching. Mrs. Pickles brought popcorn.
Five minutes. Wall. Wall. Closet. Wall.
Then I saw one last door. With a sign. Not an exit.
Wait. Every door in this house lies. So the door that says no... tells the truth.
I opened it. Sunlight! The town square! Three seconds left!
I made it! Five thousand dollars!
And right behind me? The mailman. Still holding his letter.
And this part is real. A mansion in California has stairs that go up into the ceiling, and doors that open onto walls. She kept building it for thirty eight years.
Then the Mayor gave me a golden envelope. I opened it. Inside? One more envelope.
Would you trust the door that says not an exit?
